description: Optional personal skill snapshots explicitly selected by the user; source behavior and resources are preserved.

selection.criterion: Explicitly selected by the user from the bounded usage audit
selection.caveat: Counts describe actual concrete SKILL.md file loads, not deliberate user invocations or a complete usage history. Automatic triggers may affect the counts.

privacy.included: Installed skill source and distributed support files/examples only
privacy.excluded: Session histories, user notes, runtime outputs, dependency caches, credentials and private keys
privacy.source_paths: Relative origin identifiers only; no absolute home or session paths are recorded here

skills.name: i-have-adhd
skills.compatibility_notes: Instruction-only response preference; preserve the installed invocation policy.

skills.name: gh
skills.compatibility_notes: Requires GitHub CLI and the user's own authenticated account; no authentication data is included.

skills.name: archify
skills.compatibility_notes: Includes distributed Node CLI, renderers, resources and examples; external runtime/export dependencies must be available. Rendering is not validated by this snapshot.

skills.name: find-docs
skills.compatibility_notes: Requires the external Context7/ctx7 CLI and network access; Windows CLI operation is not validated by this snapshot.

skills.name: drawio-skill
skills.compatibility_notes: Requires external draw.io/export tooling; desktop executable paths and optional runtime dependencies require local configuration.

skills.name: graphify
skills.compatibility_notes: Requires external graphify/Python tooling and optional services; original shell examples are retained and have not been ported or executed.
